description: What one chat cost on your own provider keys, estimated from public prices: per model the replies, uncached input, output, cache read and cache write tokens and the cost (a gateway reports one blended cost), the web search cost per search provider, the total and the time from the first to the last message. The same total as the chat panel. Returns the structured data and one plain-text report to show. The provider's bill is authoritative. Requires signing in (chats:read).
